title: Serapis
lead: The Greek-Egyptian god of Alexandria, said to have been brought from Sinope on the Black Sea under the first Ptolemy (Tacitus, Histories 4:83-4:84; Plutarch, On Isis and Osiris 28). Tacitus tells that the emperor Vespasian consulted him and healed two men on his word (4:81-4:82). He is not named in the Bible, which calls the gods of the nations empty (Psalm 115:4-8) and says what is sacrificed to them goes to demons (1 Corinthians 10:20).
